source: Anastasia Kireeva, Randomstrasse 101, 2026-06-05, first displayed Open Problem 35 in Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdos-Renyi graph (problems 36-38)

unchanged_count.reason: The remaining obligation changed materially: the prior worst-support kappa hypothesis was proved unnecessary inside the negatively-associated forced-support class; it was replaced by an exact matched-independent Renyi-2 domination theorem, and a fresh Che-Xu 2026 prior-art collision localized the non-novel negative-dependence mechanism.

methods.B18: Rewrote the forced-support theorem as marginal-matched-independent Renyi-2 domination. A fresh prior-art search found a close conceptual analogue in Che-Xu arXiv:2609.01944 for negatively associated participation indicators in differential privacy, so the generic NA-to-Renyi-domination mechanism is not claimed novel; the exact low-degree inference corollary remains novelty UNVERIFIED.
methods.B3: Strengthened the theorem by retaining both support copies and proving their coordinatewise intersection vector is negatively associated. This removes kappa entirely and gives D2(TP||Q) <= sum_e log(1+rho_e^2 lambda_e q_e^2) <= rho_*^2 Adv_{<=D}(P,Q)^2 for every D>=1, with heterogeneous Bernoulli null marginals and coordinatewise noise.
methods.B20: Exhibited an independent Bernoulli(1/N) support law with kappa=N->infinity but chi^2(T_rho P||Q)=(1+rho^2 lambda/N^2)^N-1->0 and Adv_{<=1}^2=lambda/N->0, proving the old worst-support kappa condition was a proof artifact caused by extremely rare large supports.

new_mathematical_results: Heterogeneous exact Fourier identity: Lhat(S)=prod_{e in S} sqrt(lambda_e) Pr(S subseteq A), so b1=sum_e lambda_e q_e^2.
Exact two-copy noisy identity: 1+chi^2(TP||Q)=E prod_e (1+rho_e^2 lambda_e 1_{e in A intersect A'}).
If the support indicator vector is negatively associated, then the coordinatewise intersection of two independent copies is negatively associated.
Matched-independent Renyi-2 domination: 1+chi^2(TP||Q) <= prod_e(1+rho_e^2 lambda_e q_e^2), hence D2(TP||Q) <= rho_*^2 Adv_{<=D}(P,Q)^2 for every D>=1.

Source-style corollary: in this structural class bounded source low-degree advantage implies a uniform full-measurable-test total-variation gap even with no noise; vanishing low-degree advantage implies TV->0.
Old-kappa failure family: independent Bernoulli(1/N) support has kappa=N but full chi-square tends to zero.
failed_routes: The preceding bounded-kappa sufficient condition is not structural: it can fail solely because an exponentially rare large support attains the supremum C.

No negatively associated forced-support counterexample with bounded low-degree advantage and noise-surviving high-degree chi-square signal exists, because the new theorem rules out that phenomenon throughout this class.
The generic probabilistic principle negative association implies marginal-matched independent Renyi domination has close current prior art (Che-Xu 2026) and is not claimed novel.
The theorem remains a structured forced-support/product-null class and is not a necessary-and-sufficient characterization for arbitrary source pairs (P_n,Q_n).
